import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    target = inputs["target_snapshot"].copy()
    cdc = inputs["cdc_events"].copy()

    # Ensure correct dtypes
    target["applied_event_ts"] = pd.to_datetime(target["applied_event_ts"])
    cdc["event_ts"] = pd.to_datetime(cdc["event_ts"])

    # Map device_id -> current watermark (applied_event_ts), may be missing for new devices
    watermark_map = target.set_index("device_id")["applied_event_ts"]

    # Attach watermark to each cdc event
    cdc = cdc.copy()
    cdc["_watermark"] = cdc["device_id"].map(watermark_map)

    # Determine which events survive:
    # - device not in target (watermark is NaT/missing) -> all events qualify
    # - device in target -> event_ts > watermark strictly
    is_new_device = cdc["_watermark"].isna() & ~cdc["device_id"].isin(watermark_map.index)
    qualifies = is_new_device | (cdc["event_ts"] > cdc["_watermark"])

    surviving = cdc[qualifies].copy()

    if not surviving.empty:
        # Sort to pick winner per device: latest (event_ts, event_seq) wins
        surviving = surviving.sort_values(
            by=["device_id", "event_ts", "event_seq"],
            ascending=[True, False, False]
        )
        winners = surviving.drop_duplicates(subset=["device_id"], keep="first")
    else:
        winners = surviving  # empty

    # Build winners lookup
    winners_map = winners.set_index("device_id")[["reading", "event_ts"]]

    # Start with target snapshot devices
    result_rows = []

    target_device_ids = set(target["device_id"].tolist())
    winner_device_ids = set(winners_map.index.tolist())

    all_device_ids = target_device_ids | winner_device_ids

    target_indexed = target.set_index("device_id")

    for device_id in all_device_ids:
        if device_id in winner_device_ids:
            # Winner takes precedence
            reading = winners_map.loc[device_id, "reading"]
            applied_event_ts = winners_map.loc[device_id, "event_ts"]
        else:
            # No surviving event for this device; carry forward
            reading = target_indexed.loc[device_id, "reading"]
            applied_event_ts = target_indexed.loc[device_id, "applied_event_ts"]

        result_rows.append({
            "device_id": device_id,
            "reading": reading,
            "applied_event_ts": applied_event_ts
        })

    new_snapshot = pd.DataFrame(result_rows, columns=["device_id", "reading", "applied_event_ts"])

    # Enforce dtypes
    new_snapshot["device_id"] = new_snapshot["device_id"].astype("int64")
    new_snapshot["reading"] = new_snapshot["reading"].astype("float64")
    new_snapshot["applied_event_ts"] = pd.to_datetime(new_snapshot["applied_event_ts"])

    return {"new_snapshot": new_snapshot}
